summary: Phase 3 (Settings + Global Search + live loyalty wiring) — 19/19 pytest tests passed. Settings CRUD, validation bounds, partial-merge persistence, public /api/settings whitelist, live-wired loyalty (PATCH 55 -> merchant redeem awarded 55 pts, ledger + /auth/me verified), global search shape, case-insensitivity, regex-escape, limit clamp (1..20), and Phase-2 categories/cities/login regression smoke all green. Defaults (brand_name='Happy Hour', default_deal_radius_km=5, loyalty_points_per_redemption=25, referral_referrer_reward=200, referral_referee_reward=100, guest_browsing_enabled=true, reels_tab_enabled=true) restored at end of run. All TEST_ users/merchants/deals/claims/points_ledger/notifications cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_panel.py PATCH /admin/settings uses `v is not None or k in {'brand_logo_url'}` — this correctly allows clearing brand_logo_url via null. Other nullable string fields (brand_name/support_email) would be treated as no-op if null is sent; acceptable given SettingsPatch defaults.
Public /api/settings has no ETag/Cache-Control — mobile clients will re-fetch on every start. Consider a short in-memory cache (5–15s) or ETag when this endpoint gets hit on cold-start.
Global search regex escape is applied (re.escape) — safe against ReDoS from user input. Good.
Search endpoint runs three queries via asyncio.gather without indexes on merchants.name/deals.title/users.email/name — fine for seed sizes but note for production scale. No blocking issue for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Created + fully cleaned up: test customers (testloyal_*, regr_*), 1 test merchant (testmerch_*), 1 test deal, 1 claim, associated ledger/notification rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 (Phase 3) fully green when run serially. NOTE: pytest.ini uses `-n auto` (xdist) — the live-loyalty test can race with parallel settings-restore tests because settings are global-mutable. If a future run flakes, run `pytest ... -o addopts=''` to force serial, or mark TestLiveLoyaltyWiring with `@pytest.mark.xdist_group('settings')` to serialize just that class. Defaults are restored on teardown regardless.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only a test-harness parallelism race observed during initial run (workers gw0 restored loyalty_points_per_redemption to 25 while gw1 was mid-redeem). Confirmed to be a test-infra issue, not a product bug: re-running serially yielded 19/19 pass and matched the expected 55-pt award, ledger entry, and /auth/me delta.
